tests: an argv element that is not a path does not turn a legitimate unmet precondition into an error that fails the whole bundle

consumesExternalOutput.program: the precondition command the runner spawns with spawnSync, and the runner's own result records and summary.json
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: src/gates/run.ts spawns the precondition command with spawnSync and derives a verdict from what that program did, so rule (f) binds. The cited capture is verbatim output of twenty-six real runs taken on 2026-08-14, node v26.6.0, thirteen one-gate-plus-companion manifests against two arms (the phase branch at 6274414, the head the delta verification examined, and fix round 2). THE TWO MEMBERS ARE STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT AND EACH KILLS A DIFFERENT ARM OF THE TEST: the first removes the not-a-path predicate, so an option, an option's code value and a URL all become path candidates again (capture rows A1 to A4); the second removes the directory allowance from the attribution scan only, leaving the predicate intact, so an operand that IS a path and exists is refused for being a directory (capture row A5). Neither subsumes the other: with only the first restored, A5 still errors; with only the second restored, A1 to A4 still error.
